implementerProof.how: Drove each of the four important review findings live on my own stack at this head with the implementer's commands or harder ones. For finding 1 I killed the series with SIGKILL instead of TERM and also tried stack.sh reset. For finding 2 I gave all eight flags with production Dispatch and listener. Finding 3 was two loadgen runs on one database with no reset; finding 4, Postgres stopped mid-window. I re-ran A1-A6 (the series included) and its negative controls, with the same results. observations: Fast-follow (message wording; the behaviour is correct): when the lock holder is in another PID namespace (another Legion role in this pod on a shared LOADTEST_ROOT, such as the default /legion/scratch/tmp/dispatch-loadtest), lock_root still refuses (exit 1) but says '... was locked by another run, and no process holds it now; the run that took it (pid ...) has exited. Try again'. I reproduced it in a scratch root: the lock was held on fd 8 by a live process, with a record pid absent from /proc.
1x committed rate at this head: 1.07, 1.07, 0.69 events/s, with the lock held 100% in each; round 2 at 11c1ac3f gave 0.28-1.41. The README's rule of five or more runs per side and medians stands.
